description: For an infinite index set I and nonzero cardinals f(i), sum_i f(i)=max(|I|,sup_i f(i)).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteSumsAndProducts.infinite_sum_eq_max.{u} {ι : Type u} [Infinite ι] (f : ι → Cardinal.{u})
  (hf : ∀ (i : ι), f i ≠ 0) : Cardinal.sum f = max (Cardinal.mk ι) (⨆ i, f i)
